item.title: From Microsoft 365 to mailcow: migrating mailboxes with the new sync jobs
item.description:
Moohoo everyone!

Many of you come to mailcow because you no longer want your email in Microsoft 365. The biggest part of the move is almost always the mailboxes. That’s why we reworked the sync jobs completely in update 2026-11: they now sign in to Microsoft 365 directly via OAuth2 and can run in parallel.

In this post we show you step by step how to move your mailboxes from Microsoft 365 to mailcow.

item.title: Quick Guide: Upgrading Debian 12 to Debian 13 for mailcow Servers
item.description:
Moohoo, dear community!

With the release of Debian 13 (Trixie), the question arises for you as administrators: How can you perform a smooth dist-upgrade from Debian 12 (Bookworm) – especially on systems running mailcow?
A commonly overlooked pitfall: Exim.
